title: Billing Conventions for Ride Minutes and Amounts (Wayfare Bikes and Scooters)
content:
Four billing conventions govern how Wayfare Bikes and Scooters ride minutes are counted and how bike amounts are stated. They are the same on every plan.

## Conventions

**C1. Minute rounding.** Ride minutes are rounded up to the next whole minute. A ride's length is therefore always stated in whole minutes.

**C2. Overtime as its own entry.** Classic bike minutes beyond the plan's included minutes are booked as a separate overtime fee entry, apart from the ride charge.

**C3. Cent rounding.** Every computed bike amount is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end of its computation. Intermediate figures are not rounded.

**C4. Full destination station.** When the destination station is full and the rider docks elsewhere, 15 free minutes are added.

## Conventions by plan

| Plan | Ride minutes | Classic minutes beyond the included minutes | Rounding of computed amounts | Free minutes added when the destination station is full |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | rounded up to the next whole minute | separate overtime fee entry | half up to the cent, once, at the end | 15 |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | rounded up to the next whole minute | separate overtime fee entry | half up to the cent, once, at the end | 15 |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | rounded up to the next whole minute | separate overtime fee entry | half up to the cent, once, at the end | 15 |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | rounded up to the next whole minute | separate overtime fee entry | half up to the cent, once, at the end | 15 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | rounded up to the next whole minute | separate overtime fee entry | half up to the cent, once, at the end | 15 |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | rounded up to the next whole minute | separate overtime fee entry | half up to the cent, once, at the end | 15 |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

The ride lengths and rates below are chosen for illustration only; they are not any plan's tariff.

- A ride lasting 12 minutes and 5 seconds counts as 13 minutes; so does a ride lasting 12 minutes and 59 seconds.
- Under an illustrative rate of 0.125 per minute, 7 minutes come to 0.875, which is rounded once, at the end, half up to 0.88.
- A computed amount of 1.124 rounds to 1.12; a computed amount of 1.125 rounds half up to 1.13.
- A classic bike ride with minutes beyond the included minutes produces two entries: the ride charge, and a separate overtime fee entry for those minutes.
